title: add-central-log-shipper-and-dashboard-migration-tooling-for-private-installs
author: Ava Chen
description: Adds a centralized log shipping option (promtail -> S3 -> loki indexer) as an optional subchart to the private-installer Helm bundle, a terraform module to provision long-term object storage and Grafana workspace configuration, and a one-shot dashboard migration utility that performs a schema-safe migration of existing Grafana dashboards during upgrades. Motivation: customers deploying Private need a reliable, upgrade-safe path to connect cluster logs and persisted dashboards into the observability stack without manual intervention. This PR implements the Helm templates and values schema, the Terraform module that creates an S3-compatible bucket with lifecycle rules and IAM policy, a k8s Job-based migration runner that performs dashboard diffs and backouts, unit and e2e tests for the chart and migration tool, and documentation + an upgrade checklist. The description below summarizes commits, changed areas, CI outcomes, and review thread.
commits: 6 commits: Add promtail subchart and values schema; Terraform: add tf module observability/s3-grafana; Grafana migration job and safe-backout script; e2e tests for chart and migration runner; docs/upgrade-checklist and examples; fix CI lint failures and retry logic
review_comments: Luis: Please ensure IAM policy generated by terraform restricts PUT only to the migration prefix and adds lifecycle rules to prevent infinite retention. Response: Updated module to accept prefix and lifecycle block, added example usage.

Priya: How will the migration handle dashboard UID changes and panel id collisions? Response: Migration runner computes a diff and will write to a backup namespace before applying; a --dry-run mode included and a safe-backout script is provided.
Owen: CI timeout on e2e test due to slow container startup. Response: increased pod readiness timeout and added retry logic to test harness; re-ran CI and all checks passed.
release_notes: - Optional Helm subchart for cluster log shipping (promtail -> S3 -> loki compatible indexer). - Terraform module to provision S3-compatible storage and Grafana workspace config. - Dashboard migration utility: dry-run, apply, and safe-backout modes. - Upgrade checklist and examples for Private deploys. - e2e tests for end-to-end validation.
notes_on_testing: Local chart unit tests via helm-unittest and schema validation added. e2e tests run in CI against a KinD cluster with mocked S3 gateway. Migration runner covered by integration test that exercises dry-run and apply paths.
motivation_and_context: Customers requested minimal-ops observability onboarding for Private installs that survives upgrades and keeps dashboards consistent. Prior manual steps were error-prone during rolling upgrades and large dashboard diffs caused outages. This PR reduces operational burden by automating provisioning, safe migration, and providing rollback tooling.
backcompat_notes: The Helm values schema is backward-compatible; new promtail subchart is opt-in via values.enablePromtail=true. Grafana dashboards are migrated only when operator flag migrator.enabled=true to avoid surprise writes.
risk_mitigation: Migration runs as a k8s Job with a preflight dry-run and creates time-stamped backups of dashboards. Terraform module outputs a recommended IAM policy and an example for least-privilege. All changes gated behind feature flags in installer values.
changelog_entry: feature: optional centralized log shipping + grafana dashboard migration for private installs
acknowledgements: Thanks to infra-team (Owen Li) for Terraform review, SRE (Luis Martinez) for alert rule guidance, and Platform PM (Priya Kapoor) for upgrade flow review.
